container_profile.scope: Read-only snapshots of the official Session's own container cgroup v2.
container_profile.limitations: memory.peak is cumulative for each container lifetime. io.stat retains device keys; stacked devices must not be summed as a physical-I/O score. Missing or unreadable metrics and counter deltas are null. Container exit/removal can destroy its cgroup. Snapshots do not include guaranteed final writeback and are not official B/M metrics.

measurement: End-to-end JSONL requests with shared index and alternating mode order. Query latency excludes workload generation and validation. Local diagnostic only.
